answer: An agent economy can deter Sybil attacks using bonded collateral anchored in an onyx ledger. Candidate nodes must lock non-refundable deposits within a validation oasis, separating legitimate operators from an ocean of ephemeral clones. This forces an attacker to incur the verifiable economic cost of forfeited capital and locked liquidity per identity. However, this financial hurdle restricts low-budget participants and fails to stop well-funded adversaries.
